desc: Read N and the sorted list X.
Compute the gaps g_i = X_{i+1} - X_i for i = 1 ... N-1.
Separate the gaps into two lists: odd_gaps for odd i and even_gaps for even i.
Sort each list in ascending order.
Compute the weighted sum by iterating positions k = 1 ... N-1: for each k take the next gap from the appropriate parity list and add (N-k) * gap.
Output N * X_1 + the weighted sum.
